subject: Stage definitions & role-play roadshow: new commit / best-case guidance
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Stage definitions & role-play roadshow: new commit / best-case guidance

Team --

Quick heads-up: finance did a pass on our Q4 numbers and flagged inconsistent usage of Commit vs. Best Case across reps. That variance is starting to materially change weekly commit numbers (we're seeing ~12% slippage when deals move stages without updated close probability).

I attached a short "Stage definitions v2" doc with concrete examples (Commit, Best Case, Pipeline) and suggested probability ranges. I want to run a short roadshow next week: 45-minute role-play + calibration sessions for SDRs + AEs focused on how to (1) categorize a deal, (2) update close date/stage contemporaneously, and (3) capture commit blockers in SFDC.

Please review the doc before Monday and confirm availability for one of the slots in the calendar I shared. Immediate asks:
- Marcus: can you run the AE role-play and bring two live deals for calibration?
- Lauren: please coordinate with CS so renewal pipeline uses same definitions.
- Ben: can you prep the action-tracker so we can audit post-training changes?

Goal: reduce stage misclassification and get commit accuracy within +/-6% by end of Q4.

Hannah
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stage-definitions-v2.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage definitions & role-play roadshow: new commit / best-case guidance

Thanks Hannah — I skimmed the doc and like the probability bands. Two quick notes:

1) For Commit, let's be prescriptive about what evidence counts (contract signed/pso, PO received, executive signoff). Without that, folks will continue to mark prematurely.
2) I can bring two deals: a multi-cloud renew and a net-new POC. Will record the session and drop clips for onboarding.

Agree we should include a short SFDC checklist to standardize fields updated at each stage (next steps, blockers, legal redlines). I can draft that checklist and attach to the training slides.

Marcus
Account Executive
